blocks.zh: 14.3.3 Needle Shield Permeability 針護套滲透性
blocks.en: 14.3.3 Needle Shield Permeability

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Needle Shield Permeability (針護套滲透性)：針護套的材質並非完全密封，水分子可以緩慢地穿透護套蒸發。當藥液中的溶劑 (通常是水) 從針尖端蒸發後，藥品濃度會局部升高，導致蛋白質析出、賦形劑結晶，最終形成堵塞。
blocks.en: Needle Shield Permeability: The needle shield material is not completely hermetic, and water molecules can slowly permeate through it and evaporate. Once the solvent in the drug solution (usually water) evaporates from the needle tip, the drug concentration rises locally, causing protein precipitation and excipient crystallization, and eventually a blockage.

blocks.zh: Plunger Stopper Discoloration (活塞膠塞變色)：膠塞與藥液中的緩衝鹽、界面活性劑長期接觸後可能產生變色。這不僅影響外觀，也可能暗示膠塞的物理性質 (如尺寸、彈性) 已發生改變，進而影響注射器功能。
blocks.en: Plunger Stopper Discoloration: After prolonged contact with buffer salts and surfactants in the drug solution, the stopper may discolor. This affects not only appearance but may also indicate that the physical properties of the stopper (such as dimensions and elasticity) have changed, which in turn can affect syringe function.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你將一杯濃咖啡用保鮮膜封住杯口，但保鮮膜有微小的透氣性。隨著時間推移，水分慢慢蒸發，杯底開始出現咖啡結晶。針護套的滲透性問題就像這個場景 — 看似密封，但長時間儲存下，微量水分流失就足以讓針尖端的藥液乾燥堵塞。
blocks.en: Imagine covering a cup of strong coffee with plastic wrap that has slight air permeability. Over time the water slowly evaporates and coffee crystals start to form at the bottom of the cup. Needle shield permeability is like this scenario: it looks sealed, but over long storage even a trace of water loss is enough to dry out the drug solution at the needle tip and block it.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 高濃度蛋白質製劑的風險更高：因為這類配方接近其溶解度極限，僅需少量溶劑蒸發即可導致析出或凝膠化。這對於目前業界趨勢 (高濃度皮下注射配方) 而言是一個關鍵挑戰。
blocks.en: Higher risk for high-concentration protein formulations: These formulations are close to their solubility limit, so only a small amount of solvent evaporation can cause precipitation or gelation. This is a key challenge for the current industry trend toward high-concentration subcutaneous formulations.

blocks.zh: 環境條件的影響：TR73 建議評估 5%~70% 相對濕度以及 25°C / 40°C 的加速條件對堵塞率的影響。低濕度環境 (如冬季暖氣房) 會加速水分流失。
blocks.en: Effect of environmental conditions: TR73 recommends evaluating the effect on clogging rate of 5%–70% relative humidity and accelerated conditions of 25°C / 40°C. Low-humidity environments (such as heated rooms in winter) accelerate water loss.

blocks.zh: 患者使用情境：拔除針護套後若未立即注射，藥液可能在針尖乾燥。這直接影響使用說明書 (IFU) 的內容設計及患者訓練計畫。
blocks.en: Patient use scenario: If the needle shield is removed and the injection is not given immediately, the drug solution may dry at the needle tip. This directly affects the content of the instructions for use (IFU) and the patient training program.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，當客戶開發高濃度單株抗體 (mAb) 預填充注射器時，你需要：
blocks.en: As a CDMO, when a client develops a high-concentration monoclonal antibody (mAb) prefilled syringe, you need to:

blocks.zh: 在穩定性試驗方案中加入針頭堵塞率測試，涵蓋不同濕度和溫度條件
blocks.en: Add needle clogging rate testing to the stability protocol, covering different humidity and temperature conditions

blocks.zh: 比較不同供應商的針護套材質，選擇水氣透過率 (MVTR) 最低的產品
blocks.en: Compare needle shield materials from different suppliers and select the product with the lowest moisture vapor transmission rate (MVTR)

blocks.zh: 協助客戶撰寫適當的注射使用說明，強調「拔護套後立即注射」
blocks.en: Help the client write appropriate injection instructions that stress "inject immediately after removing the shield"

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼高濃度蛋白質配方比低濃度配方更容易發生針頭堵塞？
blocks.en: Why are high-concentration protein formulations more prone to needle clogging than low-concentration ones?

blocks.zh: 在穩定性試驗中，為什麼需要同時評估低濕度 (5% RH) 和高濕度 (70% RH) 條件？
blocks.en: In stability studies, why do both low-humidity (5% RH) and high-humidity (70% RH) conditions need to be evaluated?

blocks.zh: 針護套拔除後產生的「先真空後正壓」現象，與哪些因素有關？
blocks.en: What factors are associated with the "vacuum first, then positive pressure" phenomenon that occurs after the needle shield is removed?

blocks.zh: 14.4 Needle Passage Shear 針道剪切力
blocks.en: 14.4 Needle Passage Shear

blocks.zh: Shear Stress (剪切應力)：流體通過狹窄通道 (如針頭) 時，因速度梯度而產生的力。對蛋白質而言，過大的剪切力可能導致分子展開 (unfolding)、聚集 (aggregation) 或變性 (denaturation)。
blocks.en: Shear Stress: The force generated by the velocity gradient when a fluid passes through a narrow channel (such as a needle). For proteins, excessive shear may cause unfolding, aggregation or denaturation.

blocks.zh: Design Space (設計空間)：基於理論計算的剪切應力值，建立一個包含不同參數組合 (針徑、針長、流速、黏度) 的實驗範圍，用於評估蛋白質在不同條件下的穩定性。這個概念源自 QbD (Quality by Design) 方法論。
blocks.en: Design Space: Based on theoretically calculated shear stress values, an experimental range is established that includes different parameter combinations (needle gauge, needle length, flow rate, viscosity) to evaluate protein stability under different conditions. The concept originates from the QbD (Quality by Design) methodology.

blocks.zh: Interfacial Interactions (界面交互作用)：部分研究顯示，蛋白質不穩定的主因並非剪切力本身，而是氣-液界面的頻繁更新所造成。這是一個重要的科學辯論。
blocks.en: Interfacial Interactions: Some studies show that the main cause of protein instability is not shear itself but the frequent renewal of the air-liquid interface. This is an important scientific debate.

blocks.zh: 想像將一條細長的麵條用力擠過一根吸管 — 擠壓過程中麵條可能斷裂或變形。蛋白質通過細針頭時也面臨類似的「擠壓變形」風險。針越細、流速越快，「擠壓力」(剪切力) 就越大。不過，有趣的是，有些研究認為麵條斷裂不是因為擠壓本身，而是因為麵條表面反覆接觸空氣而乾燥脆化 (界面效應)。
blocks.en: Imagine forcing a long thin noodle through a straw: the noodle may break or deform during the squeeze. A protein passing through a fine needle faces a similar risk of "squeeze deformation". The finer the needle and the faster the flow, the greater the "squeezing force" (shear). Interestingly, though, some studies argue that the noodle breaks not because of the squeezing itself but because its surface repeatedly contacts air, dries out and turns brittle (the interfacial effect).

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation

blocks.zh: 針頭內壁面剪切率的計算 (假設層流)：
blocks.en: Calculation of the wall shear rate inside the needle (assuming laminar flow):

blocks.zh:
壁面剪切率 (Wall Shear Rate):
  γ = 4Q / (π r³)

其中：
  Q = 體積流量 (mL/s)
  r = 針頭內徑半徑 (cm)

影響因子：
  - 針徑越小 → 剪切率大幅增加 (r³ 關係)
  - 流速越快 → 剪切率線性增加
  - 黏度越高 → 壁面剪切應力越大
blocks.en:
Wall Shear Rate:
  γ = 4Q / (π r³)

Where:
  Q = volumetric flow rate (mL/s)
  r = inner radius of the needle (cm)

Influencing factors:
  - Smaller needle diameter → shear rate increases sharply (r³ relationship)
  - Faster flow rate → shear rate increases linearly
  - Higher viscosity → higher wall shear stress

blocks.zh: CQA 評估清單：穩定性試驗應涵蓋以下穩定性指標分析：
blocks.en: CQA evaluation checklist: Stability studies should cover analysis of the following stability-indicating attributes:

blocks.zh: pH 值、蛋白質濃度
blocks.en: pH, protein concentration

blocks.zh: Aggregation (聚集) — SEC, DLS
blocks.en: Aggregation: SEC, DLS

blocks.zh: Clipping (裁切/降解) — CE-SDS
blocks.en: Clipping (fragmentation/degradation): CE-SDS

blocks.zh: Charge Profile (電荷分佈) — cIEF, CEX
blocks.en: Charge Profile: cIEF, CEX

blocks.zh: Potency (效價) — 生物活性測定
blocks.en: Potency: bioassay

blocks.zh: Oxidation (氧化) — 胜肽圖譜
blocks.en: Oxidation: peptide mapping

blocks.zh: Visible / Subvisible Particles (可見/次可見微粒)
blocks.en: Visible / Subvisible Particles

blocks.zh: 如果客戶的蛋白質藥品黏度為 20 cP，使用 27G 針頭，充填流速為 0.5 mL/s，如何評估剪切風險？
blocks.en: If the client's protein drug product has a viscosity of 20 cP, a 27G needle is used and the injection flow rate is 0.5 mL/s, how would you assess the shear risk?

blocks.zh: 為什麼實驗設計中需要將氣-液界面效應與剪切應力分離評估？
blocks.en: Why does the experimental design need to evaluate the air-liquid interface effect separately from shear stress?

blocks.zh: Design Space 的概念如何為未來的充填參數優化提供彈性？
blocks.en: How does the Design Space concept provide flexibility for future optimization of filling parameters?

blocks.zh: 14.5 Compatibility with Process Intermediates and Additives 製程中間體與添加劑之相容性
blocks.en: 14.5 Compatibility with Process Intermediates and Additives

blocks.zh: Extractables & Leachables (萃取物與溶出物)：Extractables 是在加嚴條件下從包材萃取出的物質；Leachables 是在正常儲存條件下從包材遷移到藥液中的物質。兩者的評估是 PFS 相容性研究的基礎。
blocks.en: Extractables & Leachables: Extractables are substances extracted from packaging components under aggressive conditions; leachables are substances that migrate from packaging components into the drug solution under normal storage conditions. Evaluating both is the foundation of PFS compatibility studies.

blocks.zh: Silicone Oil Compatibility (矽油相容性)：矽油作為潤滑劑廣泛用於 PFS 內壁，但不同蛋白質對矽油的敏感度差異極大。矽油液滴可能成為蛋白質聚集的成核位點，導致次可見微粒增加。
blocks.en: Silicone Oil Compatibility: Silicone oil is widely used as a lubricant on the inner wall of PFS, but the sensitivity of different proteins to silicone oil varies greatly. Silicone oil droplets can act as nucleation sites for protein aggregation, leading to an increase in subvisible particles.

blocks.zh: 就像食品包裝可能釋放塑化劑到食物中一樣，注射器內壁的材料也會緩慢地將化學物質釋放到藥液中。評估「個別影響」加上「組合影響」就像檢測食品是否同時受到包裝材料和防腐劑的雙重影響 — 單獨無害的物質，組合後可能產生意外的交互作用。
blocks.en: Just as food packaging may release plasticizers into food, the materials of the syringe inner wall also slowly release chemicals into the drug solution. Evaluating "individual effects" plus "combined effects" is like testing whether food is affected by both the packaging material and the preservative at once: substances that are harmless on their own may interact unexpectedly in combination.

blocks.zh: 本節強調了一個關鍵原則：萃取物和矽油必須同時進行個別 (individually) 及組合 (in combination) 的評估。這是因為矽油可能改變萃取物的溶出行為，或萃取物可能影響矽油層的穩定性，產生協同效應。
blocks.en: This section stresses a key principle: extractables and silicone oil must be evaluated both individually and in combination. This is because silicone oil may change the leaching behavior of extractables, or extractables may affect the stability of the silicone oil layer, producing a synergistic effect.

blocks.zh: 此外，容器表面與配方中的微粒物質 (particulate matter) 也可能與藥品發生交互作用，這是一個經常被忽視的風險領域。
blocks.en: In addition, particulate matter on container surfaces and in the formulation may also interact with the drug product, a frequently overlooked area of risk.

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要在不同矽油水準和分佈條件下進行相容性評估？
blocks.en: Why does compatibility need to be evaluated at different silicone oil levels and distributions?

blocks.zh: 容器表面的微粒物質可能如何影響藥品的品質屬性？
blocks.en: How might particulate matter on the container surface affect the quality attributes of the drug product?

blocks.zh: 14.6 Types of Silicone 矽油類型
blocks.en: 14.6 Types of Silicone

blocks.zh: Silicone Fluid / Emulsion / Dispersion (矽油液 / 矽油乳液 / 矽油分散液)：
blocks.en: Silicone Fluid / Emulsion / Dispersion:

blocks.zh: 矽油液 (Silicone Fluid)：純矽油，直接噴塗於玻璃內壁，是最傳統的矽化方式
blocks.en: Silicone Fluid: Pure silicone oil sprayed directly onto the inner glass wall; the most traditional siliconization method

blocks.zh: 矽油乳液 (Silicone Emulsion)：矽油分散在水中，適用於烘烤矽化 (baked-on siliconization) 製程
blocks.en: Silicone Emulsion: Silicone oil dispersed in water; suitable for the baked-on siliconization process

blocks.zh: 矽油分散液 (Silicone Dispersion)：矽油微粒分散在溶劑中
blocks.en: Silicone Dispersion: Silicone oil particles dispersed in a solvent

blocks.zh: Kinematic Viscosity (運動黏度)：以 cSt (centistokes) 為單位，反映矽油的流動性。低黏度矽油 (如 1,000 cSt) 流動性好，適合均勻塗布；高黏度矽油則較穩定但較難控制薄膜均勻性。
blocks.en: Kinematic Viscosity: Expressed in cSt (centistokes), it reflects the flowability of the silicone oil. Low-viscosity silicone oil (such as 1,000 cSt) flows well and suits uniform coating; high-viscosity silicone oil is more stable but makes it harder to control film uniformity.

blocks.zh: 各藥典的差異：USP 接受的黏度範圍最廣 (20-30,000 cSt)，EP 將矽油分為兩類 — 一般用途 Dimethicone (20-1,300 cSt) 和潤滑劑專用 (1,000-30,000 cSt)。日本藥典的黏度下限最低 (2 cSt)。選擇矽油時需確認目標市場的藥典合規要求。
blocks.en: Differences between pharmacopoeias: USP accepts the widest viscosity range (20-30,000 cSt); EP divides silicone oil into two categories: general-purpose Dimethicone (20-1,300 cSt) and silicone oil used as a lubricant (1,000-30,000 cSt). The Japanese Pharmacopoeia has the lowest lower viscosity limit (2 cSt). When selecting a silicone oil, confirm the pharmacopoeial compliance requirements of the target market.

blocks.zh: Tungsten (鎢) 殘留問題：玻璃注射器筒在成型過程中使用鎢針來形成針座。鎢的鹽類、氧化物及金屬微粒可能殘留在注射器中，已有文獻記錄其與蛋白質發生交互作用 (如引起聚集)。這就是為什麼需要進行鎢敏感性評估 (tungsten spiking study)。
blocks.en: Residual tungsten: In forming glass syringe barrels, tungsten pins are used to form the needle hub. Tungsten salts, oxides and metal particles may remain in the syringe, and their interaction with proteins (such as causing aggregation) has been documented in the literature. This is why a tungsten sensitivity assessment (tungsten spiking study) is needed.

blocks.zh: 矽油對 PFS 就像食用油對鍋子 — 你需要選擇合適的油 (黏度)、控制用量 (太多會滑落、太少會沾黏)，而且還必須確保這個油符合食品安全標準 (藥典規範)。不同國家有不同的食品標準，就像 USP、EP、JP 對矽油有不同的規格要求。
blocks.en: Silicone oil is to a PFS what cooking oil is to a pan: you need to choose the right oil (viscosity), control the amount (too much runs off, too little leads to sticking), and make sure the oil meets food safety standards (pharmacopoeial requirements). Different countries have different food standards, just as USP, EP and JP have different specification requirements for silicone oil.

blocks.zh: 至於鎢殘留的問題，就像新鑄造的鍋子表面可能殘留微量的金屬碎屑 — 雖然量很少，但對敏感的食材 (蛋白質藥品) 可能造成變質。
blocks.en: As for residual tungsten, it is like a newly cast pan whose surface may retain trace metal fragments: although the amount is small, it may spoil sensitive ingredients (protein drug products).

blocks.zh: 矽油檢測項目解讀
blocks.en: Interpreting the Silicone Oil Tests

blocks.zh: Table 14.6.1-1 列出的十項測試涵蓋了矽油的三大面向：
blocks.en: The ten tests listed in Table 14.6.1-1 cover three main aspects of silicone oil:

blocks.zh: 鑑定 (Identity)：紅外吸收光譜確認矽油結構
blocks.en: Identity: Infrared absorption spectrum to confirm the silicone oil structure

blocks.zh: 純度 (Purity)：礦物油、苯基化合物、重金屬、揮發物的檢測
blocks.en: Purity: Tests for mineral oil, phenylated compounds, heavy metals and volatile matter

blocks.zh: 物化性質：黏度、折射率、酸度、矽酸鹽反應
blocks.en: Physicochemical properties: Viscosity, refractive index, acidity, silicate reaction

blocks.zh: 這些測試通常由矽油供應商執行，但藥品製造商有責任確認供應商的 CoA (分析證書) 符合目標藥典的要求。
blocks.en: These tests are usually performed by the silicone oil supplier, but the drug manufacturer is responsible for confirming that the supplier's CoA (certificate of analysis) meets the requirements of the target pharmacopoeia.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 EP 將矽油分為兩個不同的專論 (Dimethicone 和 Silicone oil used as a lubricant)？這對 PFS 選擇有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why does EP divide silicone oil into two different monographs (Dimethicone and Silicone oil used as a lubricant)? What does this mean for PFS selection?

blocks.zh: 鎢 spiking study 的基本實驗設計應包含哪些要素？
blocks.en: What elements should the basic experimental design of a tungsten spiking study include?

blocks.zh: 如果你的 PFS 產品需要同時在美國、歐洲和日本上市，矽油規格應如何制定？
blocks.en: If your PFS product must be marketed in the US, Europe and Japan at the same time, how should the silicone oil specification be set?

blocks.zh: 14.7 Process-related Compatibility and Stability 製程相關之相容性與穩定性
blocks.en: 14.7 Process-related Compatibility and Stability

blocks.zh: Process-related Compatibility (製程相關相容性)：不只是藥品與包材之間的「靜態」相容性，還要評估整個製造流程中各步驟對蛋白質穩定性的「動態」影響。
blocks.en: Process-related Compatibility: This goes beyond the "static" compatibility between drug product and packaging; it also evaluates the "dynamic" effect of each step of the whole manufacturing process on protein stability.

blocks.zh: TR73 列出的關鍵製程步驟包括：
blocks.en: The key process steps listed in TR73 include:

blocks.zh: Surface Decontamination (表面去污)：注射器桶 (tub) 的外部消毒，通常使用 VHP (汽化過氧化氫)，可能產生殘留
blocks.en: Surface Decontamination: External decontamination of the syringe tub, usually with VHP (vaporized hydrogen peroxide), which may leave residues

blocks.zh: Isolator Technology (隔離器技術)：無菌充填環境，涉及 VHP 暴露
blocks.en: Isolator Technology: Aseptic filling environment, involving VHP exposure

blocks.zh: Automated Visual Inspection (自動目視檢查)：檢查過程中的機械振動和旋轉可能影響蛋白質穩定性
blocks.en: Automated Visual Inspection: Mechanical vibration and rotation during inspection may affect protein stability

blocks.zh: Labeling & Packaging (貼標與包裝)：機械處理過程中的碰撞與振動
blocks.en: Labeling & Packaging: Impact and vibration during mechanical handling

blocks.zh: 蛋白質藥品就像一個精緻的蛋糕 — 不只是配料 (配方) 和容器 (蛋糕盒) 要相容，整個從烘焙到包裝到運送的過程都可能影響成品。烤箱溫度 (滅菌)、搬運力道 (自動檢查)、包裝封盒 (貼標) 都可能讓蛋糕變形。
blocks.en: A protein drug product is like a delicate cake: it is not only the ingredients (formulation) and the container (cake box) that must be compatible; the whole process from baking to packing to delivery can affect the finished product. Oven temperature (sterilization), handling force (automated inspection) and box sealing (labeling) can all deform the cake.

blocks.zh: 雖然 TR73 未詳細討論製程相容性研究的方法，但這提醒我們：PFS 的穩定性評估不能僅限於「藥品+容器」的二元系統。所有在製程中與產品接觸或影響產品的設備和步驟，都應納入風險評估的範圍。這也是 ICH Q9 品質風險管理 (QRM) 的核心精神。
blocks.en: Although TR73 does not discuss in detail how to conduct process compatibility studies, it reminds us that PFS stability assessment cannot be limited to a binary "drug product + container" system. All equipment and steps that contact or affect the product during the process should be included in the scope of risk assessment. This is also the core spirit of ICH Q9 quality risk management (QRM).

blocks.zh: 自動目視檢查 (AVI) 過程中的哪些物理因素可能影響蛋白質的穩定性？
blocks.en: Which physical factors during automated visual inspection (AVI) may affect protein stability?

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填使用隔離器 (Isolator) 時，VHP 殘留可能對蛋白質產生什麼影響？
blocks.en: When an isolator is used for aseptic filling, what effect might VHP residues have on the protein?

blocks.zh: 14.8 Shock, Vibration, and Shipping Study 衝擊、振動與運輸研究
blocks.en: 14.8 Shock, Vibration, and Shipping Study

blocks.zh: Air-Liquid Interface (氣-液界面)：PFS 中活塞膠塞與藥液之間存在頂空 (headspace)，蛋白質分子會吸附在氣-液界面上，振動過程中界面不斷更新，加速蛋白質展開和聚集。這是 PFS 中蛋白質不穩定性的一個主要機制。
blocks.en: Air-Liquid Interface: In a PFS there is a headspace between the plunger stopper and the drug solution. Protein molecules adsorb at the air-liquid interface, and during vibration the interface is constantly renewed, accelerating protein unfolding and aggregation. This is one of the main mechanisms of protein instability in PFS.

blocks.zh: ASTM D4169-14：美國材料與試驗協會的標準，提供運輸容器和系統的性能測試方法。包含不同強度等級的振動、衝擊和壓力條件，模擬實際運輸環境。
blocks.en: ASTM D4169-14: A standard of ASTM International that provides performance test methods for shipping containers and systems. It includes vibration, shock and pressure conditions at different intensity levels to simulate the actual transport environment.

blocks.zh: Worst-case Representative Conditions (最差代表性條件)：運輸研究不是簡單的「搖一搖」。需要考慮充填量、膠塞位置、溫度、賦形劑濃度、氣壓以及運輸方式 (陸運 vs. 空運) 等多重因素的最差組合。
blocks.en: Worst-case Representative Conditions: A shipping study is not simply "shaking it". The worst-case combination of multiple factors must be considered, including fill volume, stopper position, temperature, excipient concentration, air pressure and mode of transport (ground vs. air).

blocks.zh: 想像你是一家精緻甜點店，需要將易碎的慕斯蛋糕從工廠配送到全國各地的門市。蛋糕 (蛋白質) 在靜置時很穩定，但運送途中的顛簸 (振動)、急煞車 (衝擊) 都可能讓蛋糕變形。而且蛋糕盒裡的空氣層 (頂空) 會讓蛋糕表面反覆接觸空氣而乾燥龜裂。你需要用真實的配送路線做測試，或用搖晃機器模擬最惡劣的路況。
blocks.en: Imagine you run a fine dessert shop and need to deliver fragile mousse cakes from the factory to outlets across the country. The cake (protein) is stable at rest, but bumps on the road (vibration) and sudden braking (shock) can deform it. The layer of air in the cake box (headspace) also makes the cake surface repeatedly contact air, dry out and crack. You need to test with real delivery routes, or use a shaking machine to simulate the worst road conditions.

blocks.zh: 兩階段評估策略：
blocks.en: Two-stage evaluation strategy:

blocks.zh: 配方開發階段：透過搖晃 (agitation) 研究，初步評估不同配方對動態應力的耐受性
blocks.en: Formulation development stage: Use agitation studies to make an initial evaluation of how well different formulations tolerate dynamic stress

blocks.zh: 最終配方確定後：進行正式的運輸研究 (shipping study)，使用 ASTM D4169 標準或實際運輸
blocks.en: After the final formulation is set: Perform a formal shipping study, using the ASTM D4169 standard or actual shipments

blocks.zh: 運輸模擬 vs. 實際運輸：如果模擬能經驗證證明其代表性 (representative)，且產生的應力高於實際運輸，則可以取代實際運輸測試。但需注意空運時的低氣壓條件（可能導致頂空膨脹），這是陸運模擬無法完全涵蓋的。
blocks.en: Simulated vs. actual shipping: If a simulation is shown to be representative through verification and generates higher stress than actual shipping, it can replace actual shipping tests. Note, however, the low-pressure conditions during air transport (which may cause headspace expansion), which a ground transport simulation cannot fully cover.

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO 在規劃 PFS 運輸驗證時，應考慮以下實際情境：
blocks.en: As a CDMO planning PFS shipping validation, you should consider the following real-world scenarios:

blocks.zh: 全球配送：若產品需從台灣工廠配送至歐美市場，運輸鏈可能包含卡車→港口→貨機→卡車→冷鏈倉庫→最後一哩配送，每個環節的振動特性不同
blocks.en: Global distribution: If the product is shipped from a Taiwan facility to European and US markets, the transport chain may include truck → port → cargo aircraft → truck → cold-chain warehouse → last-mile delivery, with different vibration characteristics at each stage

blocks.zh: 季節因素：夏季高溫和冬季低溫對蛋白質穩定性的影響不同，需納入最差條件設計
blocks.en: Seasonal factors: High summer temperatures and low winter temperatures affect protein stability differently, so they should be built into the worst-case design

blocks.zh: 充填量的影響：充填量越少，頂空比例越大，氣-液界面效應越顯著
blocks.en: Effect of fill volume: The lower the fill volume, the larger the headspace proportion and the more pronounced the air-liquid interface effect

blocks.zh: 為什麼蛋白質在氣-液界面特別容易聚集？與矽油/溶液界面有什麼異同？
blocks.en: Why are proteins particularly prone to aggregation at the air-liquid interface? How does this compare with the silicone oil/solution interface?

blocks.zh: ASTM D4169 標準中的運輸模擬與實際運輸各有什麼優缺點？
blocks.en: What are the advantages and disadvantages of simulated shipping under ASTM D4169 versus actual shipping?

blocks.zh: 如果產品需要空運配送，運輸研究中需要額外考慮哪些因素？
blocks.en: If the product is to be shipped by air, what additional factors need to be considered in the shipping study?

blocks.zh: 頂空使用惰性氣體 (如氮氣) 替代空氣，是否能降低運輸過程中的蛋白質聚集風險？為什麼？
blocks.en: Would replacing air in the headspace with an inert gas (such as nitrogen) reduce the risk of protein aggregation during shipping? Why?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 針護套滲透性 (14.3.3)：水分可透過針護套蒸發，導致針尖藥液乾燥堵塞。高濃度蛋白質配方風險尤高，需在不同濕度/溫度條件下評估堵塞率，並據此設計患者使用說明。
blocks.en: Needle shield permeability (14.3.3): Water can evaporate through the needle shield, drying the drug solution at the needle tip and causing clogging. The risk is especially high for high-concentration protein formulations; clogging rate should be evaluated under different humidity/temperature conditions and the patient instructions designed accordingly.

blocks.zh: 針道剪切力 (14.4)：蛋白質通過細針頭時承受剪切應力，可能導致展開、聚集或變性。需建立包含針徑、流速、黏度的設計空間，並將氣-液界面效應與剪切效應分離評估。穩定性指標應涵蓋 pH、濃度、聚集、裁切、電荷、效價、氧化及微粒。
blocks.en: Needle passage shear (14.4): Proteins passing through a fine needle experience shear stress, which may cause unfolding, aggregation or denaturation. A design space covering needle gauge, flow rate and viscosity should be established, and the air-liquid interface effect should be evaluated separately from the shear effect. Stability-indicating attributes should cover pH, concentration, aggregation, clipping, charge, potency, oxidation and particles.

blocks.zh: 製程中間體相容性 (14.5)：萃取物與矽油需個別及組合評估，材料表面與微粒物質也可能與藥品交互作用。
blocks.en: Compatibility with process intermediates (14.5): Extractables and silicone oil should be evaluated individually and in combination; material surfaces and particulate matter may also interact with the drug product.

blocks.zh: 矽油類型 (14.6)：三種主要矽化材料 (矽油液、乳液、分散液) 各有不同黏度範圍，且 USP、EP、JP 的規格要求不同。矽油供應商須通過十項藥典檢測。鎢殘留是玻璃 PFS 特有的萃取物風險，需進行 spiking study。
blocks.en: Types of silicone (14.6): The three main siliconization materials (fluid, emulsion, dispersion) each have different viscosity ranges, and the USP, EP and JP specification requirements differ. The silicone oil supplier must pass the ten pharmacopoeial tests. Residual tungsten is an extractables risk specific to glass PFS and requires a spiking study.

blocks.zh: 製程相關相容性 (14.7)：從去污、充填、檢查到包裝，每個製程步驟都可能影響蛋白質穩定性，需納入整體風險評估。
blocks.en: Process-related compatibility (14.7): From decontamination and filling to inspection and packaging, every process step may affect protein stability and should be included in the overall risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 運輸研究 (14.8)：PFS 中的氣-液界面在振動條件下加速蛋白質聚集。需分兩階段評估 — 配方開發時的搖晃研究及最終配方的正式運輸研究 (依 ASTM D4169 或實際運輸)。最差條件設計須涵蓋充填量、膠塞位置、溫度、賦形劑、氣壓及運輸方式。
blocks.en: Shipping studies (14.8): The air-liquid interface in a PFS accelerates protein aggregation under vibration. Evaluation should be done in two stages: agitation studies during formulation development and a formal shipping study of the final formulation (per ASTM D4169 or actual shipping). The worst-case design must cover fill volume, stopper position, temperature, excipients, air pressure and mode of transport.
